name: gl-transitions
notes: 2026-11-24: Toolkit guide written from partial Fade-only evidence (examples/gl-transitions-seek).
2026-11-15: Triage reason: Assess source-specific licenses and host-renderer integration. Revisit when a seekable shader transition workflow is needed.
2026-11-15: Legacy schema value used for a listed-only candidate; this is not evidence of PRD inclusion.

evidence.result: partial: Fade in raw WebGL1 between two 2x2 solid textures under ANGLE SwiftShader (Vulkan). Progress 0, 0.5, 1 centre rgb 200,40,0 / 100,80,128 / 0,120,255 within 2 per channel; each checked frame one colour. 61 frames 640x360, 61 distinct hashes, shuffled equals sequential. Alpha check not measurable: PNG has no alpha channel.
evidence.scope: Fade seeked by progress in raw WebGL1 on SwiftShader, macOS arm64; shuffled equals sequential. No alpha, other transitions, Metal or other GPUs.

use_when: Use its progress-parameterized transition shaders across supported render targets
Choose a ready-made wipe or dissolve shader before writing a custom effect
avoid_when: Use a renderer-specific shader when the transition needs custom scene data
Use FFmpeg transitions for a command-line filtergraph rather than GLSL shaders

assessment.rationale: Collection of progress-parameterized GLSL transitions with generated shader targets and CI render comparisons. MIT collection with some BSD individual transitions; select per-file licence.
